nodes.description: Immutable ERC20 token held in escrow by the timelock.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp (rounded down to a day) of the vesting period.
End timestamp of the release period; mutable via terminate().
Total amount of tokens subject to vesting; rewritten by terminate().
Running total of tokens already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag marking the contract as terminated so terminate() cannot run twice.
Constant 86400 used to round timestamps and compute elapsed days.
Owner address stored by Ownable; used by onlyOwner and as recipient of terminated funds.
Constructor: wires token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit, and validates the release end time.
View returning the escrowed token.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
Computes the vested amount from block.timestamp, release window and total benefit using integer arithmetic.
Returns _totalBenefit minus releasedBalance().
View returning the already withdrawn balance.
Withdraws the released-but-not-yet-withdrawn amount to the beneficiary via SafeERC20.
Owner-only, one-shot termination: crystallises released balance, shortens the window to now and sends the remainder to the owner.
Returns the current owner; used by onlyOwner and by terminate() as transfer recipient.
Private helper that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only transfer of ownership to a non-zero address.
Owner-only renouncement setting owner to address(0).
Returns msg.sender; the indirection used by the onlyOwner access-control check.
Wraps IERC20.transfer with a low-level optional-return call.
Performs the encoded token call through Address.functionCall and optionally decodes a bool return.
Low-level call wrapper that validates the target is a contract and bubbles revert reasons.
Sends ETH with a full-gas low-level call to a payable recipient.
Decreases allowance inside an unchecked block after a >= check.
Miner/validator-controllable time value driving vesting calculations, term limits and the termination window rewrite.
Caller address used by the onlyOwner access-control checks.
External token transfer to _beneficiary inside withdraw() while withdrawal bookkeeping is only partially finalised.
External token transfer to owner() inside terminate() based on a balance computed from mutable state.
recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwards all gas to an arbitrary address, enabling reentrancy on the caller.
target.call{value: value}(data) low-level call to an arbitrary contract address.
_totalBenefit * passedDays / totalDays and related subtractions: arithmetic whose operands derive from timestamp-derived day counts.
Unchecked subtraction oldAllowance - value inside SafeERC20.safeDecreaseAllowance.
ERC20 token address passed to the constructor.
Beneficiary address passed to the constructor.
Release start timestamp passed to the constructor, rounded to a day boundary.
Number of timelock days passed to the constructor.
Total benefit amount passed to the constructor.
Local in withdraw(): releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
Local in terminate(): contract token balance minus unreleased remainder.
Local in releasedBalance(): elapsed whole days since _releaseStartTime.
Local in releasedBalance(): total whole days of the release window.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership().
New owner address passed to _setOwner().
Local in _setOwner(): previous value of _owner kept for the event.
Payable recipient passed to Address.sendValue().
Wei amount passed to Address.sendValue().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns token_ into the immutable _token state variable.
Constructor assigns beneficiary_ into the immutable _beneficiary state variable.
Constructor rounds releaseStartTime_ by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY and stores it in _releaseStartTime.
Constructor derives _releaseEndTime from daysOfTimelock_.
Constructor stores totalBenefit_ into _totalBenefit.
Constructor require() compares _releaseEndTime with block.timestamp, making deployment time-dependent.
releasedBalance reads _releaseStartTime to compute elapsed days.
releasedBalance reads _releaseEndTime to compute total days and the end-of-vesting branch.
releasedBalance scales _totalBenefit by the elapsed fraction of the period.
releasedBalance uses SECONDS_OF_A_DAY to convert timestamps into days.
releasedBalance branches and computes entirely from miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
releasedBalance computes the passedDays local from timestamps.
releasedBalance computes the totalDays local from the release window.
_totalBenefit is the multiplicand of the vesting arithmetic.
passedDays feeds the multiplication in releasedBalance.
totalDays is the divisor in releasedBalance and can be zero after terminate() rewrites the window.
releasedBalance executes the multi-step multiplication/division that determines the payout.
unreleasedBalance calls releasedBalance.
releasedBalance result feeds the unreleasedBalance subtraction.
_totalBenefit is the minuend in unreleasedBalance.
withdrawedBalance returns _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw calls releasedBalance twice for its checks and amount computation.
releasedBalance return value determines the withdraw amount.
withdraw reads and later increments _withdrawedBalance.
withdraw queries token balance and transfers through the stored token.
withdraw sends the released amount to _beneficiary.
withdraw computes amount = releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
amount is the value passed to the external safeTransfer call.
withdraw performs an external token transfer before the function completes, exposing reentrancy if the token has hooks.
Transferred tokens are sent to the beneficiary state variable.
withdraw delegates the transfer to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
safeTransfer builds calldata and calls _callOptionalReturn.
_callOptionalReturn performs the raw call through Address.functionCall.
terminate calls releasedBalance to crystallise the released amount.
releasedBalance value determines the new _totalBenefit and the residual transfer.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with releasedBalance().
terminate reads _withdrawedBalance when computing the owner payout.
terminate reads the contract token balance and transfers through the token.
terminate sets _isTerminated and is guarded by the isNotTerminated modifier.
terminate rewrites _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp, collapsing the vesting window.
terminate is protected by onlyOwner, so msg.sender gates who can drain the remainder.
terminate computes amountToWithdraw from token balance and unreleased remainder.
amountToWithdraw is the value passed to the external transfer.
terminate performs an external token transfer to the owner while state was just rewritten.
The owner() address is the recipient of the terminated funds.
terminate delegates the payout to SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership's onlyOwner modifier calls owner().
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender(), gating transferOwnership.
_msgSender returns msg.sender.
renounceOwnership calls _setOwner(address(0)).
transferOwnership calls _setOwner(newOwner).
newOwner from transferOwnership is forwarded to _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new owner into _owner.
_setOwner caches the previous _owner in oldOwner for the event.
onlyOwner checks _msgSender() before renounceOwnership executes.
renounceOwnership's onlyOwner modifier calls owner().
Address.functionCall ends in a low-level call with value forwarding, which can hand control back to an attacker.
Address.sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}(""), transferring control and funds to an arbitrary address.
recipient parameter is used by Address.sendValue.
amount parameter is used by Address.sendValue.
recipient is the call target of the low-level value transfer.
amount is the value forwarded in the low-level call.
safeDecreaseAllowance executes an unchecked subtraction of value from oldAllowance.
